Senses.Explanation: 裴休 is Pei Xiu, the Tang official recorded as a lay questioner and preface writer. In the Chuandeng lu he visits a hermitage, asks whether the resident has attendants, and recoils when two tigers appear. Three later lamp compilations transmit the notice 裴休為之序曰 and the same signed preface, where Pei describes separate inherited teachings as doorways and scriptures and treatises as weapons in mutual attack. Those three are parallel witnesses to one preface, not three independent events.
